_comment: Crop catalog derived from Eastern Market 90-day sales data (2026-05-24 refresh). Items ranked by receipt count. unlock_level chosen for smooth Hay-Day-style early progression. Mushrooms are intentionally absent here — they will live in a separate 'mushroom_house' building (V2). Old crops (tomato/cucumber/garlic) dropped because they were not in the store's top sellers; player saves with those plot crops are migrated to empty on load (see state.init).

shanghai_miao.story_zh: 比普通上海青还嫩，叶子小、味道清甜。东方超市每周到货 3 次，是凉拌或快炒的好搭档。
shanghai_miao.story_en: Smaller and sweeter than regular bok choy. Eastern Market gets a fresh batch three times a week. Top seller!
shanghai_miao.recipe_zh: 蒜蓉上海苗：上海苗 + 蒜末 + 几滴生抽，热油下锅 60 秒。
shanghai_miao.recipe_en: Garlic Shanghai bok choy: bok choy + minced garlic + dash of soy sauce, 60 seconds in a hot wok.

xiao_cong.story_zh: 中餐厨房少不了的香味剂。东方超市 50 美分一捆，最便宜的鲜香。
xiao_cong.story_en: The flavor backbone of Chinese cooking. 50 cents per bunch at Eastern Market — cheap freshness.
xiao_cong.recipe_zh: 葱花蛋汤、小葱拌豆腐、葱姜爆炒任何菜。
xiao_cong.recipe_en: Egg drop soup, tofu with scallion, scallion-ginger stir-fry for anything.

cilantro.story_zh: 爱的人很爱，不爱的人「这是肥皂吧」。基因决定。店里 90 天卖出 255 笔，是热门 Top 5。
cilantro.story_en: You either love it or it tastes like soap to you. Genetic, actually. Top 5 seller at Eastern Market.
cilantro.recipe_zh: 凉拌牛肉、火锅蘸料、葱姜蒜的最佳搭档。
cilantro.recipe_en: Garnish for cold beef, hotpot dip, soups. Trio-essential with scallion and ginger.

you_mai_cai.story_zh: 比生菜叶子长、更脆，带一点点苦回甘。火锅必点。
you_mai_cai.story_en: Longer leaf, crunchier than lettuce, with a subtle bitter-sweet finish. A hotpot must.
you_mai_cai.recipe_zh: 腐乳油麦菜：油麦菜 + 腐乳一小块 + 蒜末，热油快炒。
you_mai_cai.recipe_en: A choy with fermented tofu: a choy + spoon of fermented tofu + garlic, quick stir-fry.

cai_xin.story_zh: 粤菜叶菜之王。茎部脆甜，最简单的白灼就好吃。
cai_xin.story_en: Cantonese king of leafy greens. Crunchy sweet stems — simplest blanched preparation shines.
cai_xin.recipe_zh: 白灼菜心：开水加点油盐，烫 90 秒，淋蒜蓉酱油。
cai_xin.recipe_en: Blanched you choy: salt+oil in boiling water, 90s, drizzle with garlic-soy.

ji_mao_cai.story_zh: 上海青最幼小的形态，整棵能吃。叶子像鸡毛一样细嫩。
ji_mao_cai.story_en: Youngest form of bok choy, eat the whole plant. Leaves as tender as feathers.
ji_mao_cai.recipe_zh: 鸡毛菜豆腐汤：鸡毛菜 + 嫩豆腐 + 姜丝，10 分钟一锅汤。
ji_mao_cai.recipe_en: Baby bok choy + tofu soup: baby bok choy + soft tofu + ginger, 10-min one-pot soup.

tong_hao.story_zh: 火锅最香的菜之一，特殊的草本香气。北方叫蓬蒿菜。
tong_hao.story_en: One of the most aromatic hotpot greens, with a distinctive herbaceous fragrance.
tong_hao.recipe_zh: 清炒茼蒿：热油加蒜片，茼蒿大火快炒 1 分钟。
tong_hao.recipe_en: Stir-fried crown daisy: hot oil + garlic, toss crown daisy on high heat 1 min.

bo_cai.story_zh: 铁含量高，凉拌焯水后更鲜甜。冬天的菠菜最甜，叫「霜打菠菜」。
bo_cai.story_en: Iron-rich; blanched then dressed becomes sweeter. Winter spinach (after frost) is sweetest.
bo_cai.recipe_zh: 凉拌菠菜：焯水后挤干 + 香油 + 蒜末 + 几滴醋，5 分钟一道菜。
bo_cai.recipe_en: Cold spinach salad: blanch + squeeze dry + sesame oil + garlic + vinegar, 5 min.

wa_wa_cai.story_zh: 比大白菜小一圈、更嫩。火锅、煲汤、清炒都合适。
wa_wa_cai.story_en: Smaller, more tender than regular napa cabbage. Versatile: hotpot, soup, stir-fry.
wa_wa_cai.recipe_zh: 蒜蓉粉丝娃娃菜：粉丝铺底、娃娃菜切条、蒜蓉酱汁浇上，蒸 10 分钟。
wa_wa_cai.recipe_en: Wawacai with garlic vermicelli: vermicelli bed, sliced wawacai on top, garlic sauce, steam 10 min.

xi_lan_hua.story_zh: 新鲜西兰花花苞紧实、颜色翠绿。蒜蓉炒一炒就好吃。
xi_lan_hua.story_en: Fresh broccoli has tight florets and bright green color. Garlic stir-fry is all you need.
xi_lan_hua.recipe_zh: 蒜蓉西兰花：焯水 30 秒后过冷水，蒜蓉热油 60 秒炒香即可。
xi_lan_hua.recipe_en: Garlic broccoli: blanch 30s then cold water, garlic in hot oil 60s, toss together.

niu_jiao_jiao.story_zh: 中等辣度的尖椒，肉厚味香。比朝天椒温和，比甜椒带劲。
niu_jiao_jiao.story_en: Medium-heat pointed pepper, thick-walled and aromatic. Milder than bird's eye, kickier than bell.
niu_jiao_jiao.recipe_zh: 虎皮椒：整根牛角椒煎到起皮，加蒜醋酱油，下饭神器。
niu_jiao_jiao.recipe_en: Tiger-skin peppers: whole peppers pan-fried until blistered, garlic-vinegar-soy dressing.

da_bai_cai.story_zh: 北方冬天囤菜的首选。一颗能吃一周：炒、炖、馅、酸菜。
da_bai_cai.story_en: Northern China's winter staple. One head feeds you a week: stir-fry, stew, dumplings, pickled.
da_bai_cai.recipe_zh: 醋溜白菜：白菜帮切片、热油爆香干辣椒、加醋糖快炒，酸甜微辣。
da_bai_cai.recipe_en: Sweet-sour cabbage: white stems sliced, sizzle dried chili, add vinegar+sugar, quick fry.

jiucai.story_zh: 韭菜越割越旺，所以又叫「起阳草」。游戏里也是 — 种一次能割三次。店里 90 天 #3 大销量。
jiucai.story_en: Chinese chives grow back after cutting — plant once, harvest three times. Top 3 best-seller.
jiucai.recipe_zh: 韭菜炒蛋 / 韭菜盒子 / 包饺子，万能配菜。
jiucai.recipe_en: Stir-fry with eggs, fill dumplings, or make chive pockets. Endless uses.

suan_tai.story_zh: 大蒜抽的花茎，脆甜带蒜香。春末最当季。店里 196 笔，蔬菜 #8。
suan_tai.story_en: Garlic plant's flower stem — crunchy, sweet, mild garlic flavor. Peak in late spring.
suan_tai.recipe_zh: 蒜苔炒肉：蒜苔切寸段 + 肉丝，大火爆炒 2 分钟。
suan_tai.recipe_en: Garlic scapes with pork: cut into 1-inch pieces + shredded pork, high heat 2 min.

bai_luo_bo.story_zh: 冬吃萝卜夏吃姜。萝卜炖排骨、萝卜丝煎饼、糖醋萝卜，全能。
bai_luo_bo.story_en: Winter staple. Daikon-pork rib stew, shredded daikon pancakes, sweet-sour daikon — endlessly versatile.
bai_luo_bo.recipe_zh: 萝卜丝饼：白萝卜擦丝挤干 + 面粉 + 葱花，平底锅煎至两面金黄。
bai_luo_bo.recipe_en: Daikon pancakes: grated daikon (squeezed) + flour + scallion, pan-fry till golden.

hu_luo_bo.story_zh: 维生素 A 之王。中国胡萝卜比西方甜，生吃就很好吃。
hu_luo_bo.story_en: Vitamin A king. Chinese carrots are sweeter than Western ones — eat raw and you'll taste it.
hu_luo_bo.recipe_zh: 胡萝卜炒蛋：胡萝卜丝 + 鸡蛋打散，10 分钟一道家常菜。
hu_luo_bo.recipe_en: Carrot and egg stir-fry: shredded carrot + beaten eggs, 10 min home cooking.

wo_sun.story_zh: 店里 90 天卖出 326 笔，是全店蔬菜第一名！茎部削皮后清炒脆嫩多汁，叶子可单独凉拌。
wo_sun.story_en: Eastern Market's #1 vegetable — 326 receipts in 90 days! Peeled stems are crunchy stir-fry magic.
wo_sun.recipe_zh: 凉拌莴笋丝：莴笋去皮切丝 + 蒜末 + 香油 + 醋，10 分钟一道清爽小菜。
wo_sun.recipe_en: Cold celtuce strips: peel + julienne + garlic + sesame oil + vinegar, 10-min crisp side.

eggplant.story_zh: 长茄子和西方圆茄子不一样 — 更细长，皮薄籽少，不需要先用盐杀苦水。
eggplant.story_en: Long Asian eggplant is much milder than Western round eggplant. No need to salt out bitterness.
eggplant.recipe_zh: 鱼香茄子：长茄子切条，过油后下蒜末豆瓣酱，咸甜微辣。
eggplant.recipe_en: Yuxiang eggplant: cut into strips, fry briefly, then sauce with garlic and doubanjiang.

tw_cauliflower.story_zh: 比普通椰菜花更松软、风味更清甜。店里 175 笔，蔬菜 #11。
tw_cauliflower.story_en: Looser and sweeter than regular cauliflower. Top 11 best-seller (175 receipts).
tw_cauliflower.recipe_zh: 干锅椰菜花：椰菜花掰小朵焯水，五花肉煸香加椰菜花干煸出锅。
tw_cauliflower.recipe_en: Dry-pot cauliflower: break into florets, blanch, then dry-fry with pork belly.

dong_gua.story_zh: 夏天清热神器。煲汤后入口即化，吸足肉香。
dong_gua.story_en: Summer cooling specialty. Melts in your mouth after long-simmered soup, absorbs meat flavor.
dong_gua.recipe_zh: 冬瓜薏米排骨汤：冬瓜块 + 薏米 + 排骨，煲 90 分钟，清爽不腻。
dong_gua.recipe_en: Winter melon + barley + pork rib soup: simmer 90 min for a light, refreshing broth.

jing_cong.story_zh: 比小葱粗，比大葱嫩。北方烤鸭、卤煮、爆锅都少不了它。
jing_cong.story_en: Thicker than scallions, more tender than leeks. Essential for Peking duck, soups, and stir-fry bases.
jing_cong.recipe_zh: 葱爆牛肉：京葱切段 + 牛肉片，大火爆炒 90 秒。
jing_cong.recipe_en: Scallion-blasted beef: cut leek + thin beef slices, high heat 90 seconds.

lian_ou.story_zh: 中超特色。切片清炒爽脆，整段煲汤粉糯。店里 90 天卖出 200 笔。
lian_ou.story_en: An Eastern Market staple — 200 receipts. Sliced for crunchy stir-fry, whole for creamy soup.
lian_ou.recipe_zh: 凉拌藕片：莲藕切薄片焯水，加香醋糖蒜末凉拌。
lian_ou.recipe_en: Cold lotus root slices: thin slice + quick blanch + vinegar + sugar + garlic.

shan_yao.story_zh: 削皮时会有粘液，戴手套切。煲汤养胃，是冬天的滋补品。
shan_yao.story_en: Slimy when peeled — wear gloves. Soup-simmered, it's a winter nutritional staple.
shan_yao.recipe_zh: 山药排骨汤：山药段 + 排骨 + 玉米 + 几片姜，慢炖 90 分钟。
shan_yao.recipe_en: Yam + pork rib + corn soup: chunks of yam, ribs, corn, ginger — simmer 90 min.

chun_sun.story_zh: 春天限定。脆嫩鲜甜，焖肉一绝。一年只有 2-3 个月有新鲜的。
chun_sun.story_en: Spring only. Crunchy, sweet, tender — braised with pork is heaven. Only 2-3 months a year.
chun_sun.recipe_zh: 油焖春笋：春笋切滚刀块，热油加糖红烧 15 分钟。
chun_sun.recipe_en: Oil-braised spring bamboo: cut into chunks, hot oil + sugar, braise 15 min.

sheng_jiang.story_zh: 中餐去腥提味的灵魂。姜茶感冒退烧，姜醋驱寒。东方超市常备。
sheng_jiang.story_en: The soul of Chinese cooking — degreases meat, adds warmth. Ginger tea fights colds.
sheng_jiang.recipe_zh: 姜醋汁：嫩姜切丝 + 镇江香醋 + 一点糖，配蒸鱼绝杀。
sheng_jiang.recipe_en: Ginger-vinegar dip: julienned young ginger + black vinegar + pinch of sugar, perfect for steamed fish.

pa_pa_gan.story_zh: 店里水果第一名（91 笔）。皮软汁多，比一般橘子甜。冬春当季。
pa_pa_gan.story_en: Eastern Market's #1 fruit (91 receipts). Soft skin, juicy, sweeter than regular tangerines.
pa_pa_gan.recipe_zh: 直接剥皮吃。冬天屯一箱，几天就吃完。
pa_pa_gan.recipe_en: Just peel and eat. Stock a case in winter, gone in days.

ye_zi.story_zh: 店里 86 笔，水果 #2。砍开喝椰汁、刮椰肉。夏天解暑神器。
ye_zi.story_en: Eastern Market #2 fruit (86 receipts). Hack open for juice and tender meat. Summer essential.
ye_zi.recipe_zh: 椰子鸡汤：整只椰子加水煲鸡，鲜甜清香。
ye_zi.recipe_en: Coconut chicken soup: whole coconut water + chicken, sweet and aromatic.

xiang_yin_putao.story_zh: 颗粒大、清脆爆汁、带玫瑰花香。店里夏秋季节的招牌水果。
xiang_yin_putao.story_en: Big crisp grapes that pop with floral muscat aroma. Summer/fall signature fruit.
xiang_yin_putao.recipe_zh: 洗净直接吃。冷藏后更脆甜。
xiang_yin_putao.recipe_en: Wash and eat. Refrigerate for extra crunch.

mang_guo.story_zh: Peru 芒果当季最甜。切井字、翻起来吃，无需吐核。
mang_guo.story_en: Peruvian mangoes are peak-sweet. Hedge-cut and invert — no pit struggle.
mang_guo.recipe_zh: 芒果糯米饭：糯米 + 椰浆 + 切片芒果，泰式经典。
mang_guo.recipe_en: Mango sticky rice: glutinous rice + coconut milk + sliced mango. Thai classic.

huo_long_guo.story_zh: 红肉甜度高、白肉更清淡。富含纤维。店里 44 笔。
huo_long_guo.story_en: Red-fleshed sweeter, white-fleshed milder. High fiber. 44 receipts.
huo_long_guo.recipe_zh: 火龙果切丁加酸奶 + 蜂蜜，水果沙拉。
huo_long_guo.recipe_en: Cube into yogurt + honey, fruit salad ready.

wo_gan.story_zh: 皮稍硬，但极甜多汁。冬春季节店里常备。
wo_gan.story_en: Firmer skin but extremely sweet and juicy. A winter/spring staple.
wo_gan.recipe_zh: 剥开当零食。糖度高，2 个能顶 1 顿水果。
wo_gan.recipe_en: Peel and snack. So sweet that 2 fruits = one fruit serving.

pi_pa.story_zh: 春末初夏限定。中医里能润肺止咳，做枇杷膏用的就是它。
pi_pa.story_en: Late spring / early summer only. Used in TCM to soothe coughs (枇杷膏 syrup).
pi_pa.recipe_zh: 枇杷雪梨炖冰糖：枇杷去皮去核 + 雪梨 + 冰糖，炖 30 分钟，润喉。
pi_pa.recipe_en: Loquat-pear sweet soup: peeled loquats + Asian pear + rock sugar, simmer 30 min for sore throats.

sha_tang_ju.story_zh: 小、薄皮、超甜。一抓一把吃。冬天年货必备。
sha_tang_ju.story_en: Small, thin-skinned, super sweet. Grab a handful. Winter New Year essential.
sha_tang_ju.recipe_zh: 整袋摆桌上，看电视一颗接一颗。
sha_tang_ju.recipe_en: Bag on coffee table, eat while watching TV. One after another.

tomato.story_zh: 熟透的番茄沙瓤多汁，凉拌、炒蛋、煮汤都百搭。
tomato.story_en: Vine-ripened tomatoes are juicy and sweet — great raw, scrambled with egg, or in soup.
tomato.recipe_zh: 番茄炒蛋：番茄切块炒出沙，下蛋液同炒，咸里带甜。
tomato.recipe_en: Tomato & egg stir-fry: cook tomatoes till saucy, fold in beaten eggs.

cucumber.story_zh: 脆嫩多汁的黄瓜，拍一拍拌蒜最爽口。
cucumber.story_en: Crisp, juicy cucumber — smash it and toss with garlic for the classic cold dish.
cucumber.recipe_zh: 拍黄瓜：黄瓜拍碎，蒜末、香醋、香油一拌即成。
cucumber.recipe_en: Smashed cucumber: smash, then dress with garlic, vinegar and sesame oil.

yu_mi.story_zh: 萨省本地夏末也产甜玉米，水煮就很甜。东方超市夏季常到货，烧烤季抢手。
yu_mi.story_en: Saskatchewan grows sweet corn too! Boiled fresh it needs nothing else. A summer staple at Eastern Market.
yu_mi.recipe_zh: 松仁玉米：玉米粒 + 松子 + 少许青豆快炒，加一点糖提鲜，孩子最爱。
yu_mi.recipe_en: Corn with pine nuts: stir-fry kernels + pine nuts + peas with a pinch of sugar — a kids' favourite.

ku_gua.story_zh: 苦口良菜，广东人夏天离不开的下火菜。会吃的人吃它的回甘。
ku_gua.story_en: Bitter but beloved — Cantonese families swear by it to beat summer heat. The bitterness turns sweet if you know it.
ku_gua.recipe_zh: 苦瓜炒蛋：苦瓜切薄片盐腌 10 分钟去苦，猛火快炒加蛋，下饭神器。
ku_gua.recipe_en: Bitter melon eggs: salt thin slices 10 min to tame the bite, then flash-fry with beaten eggs.

li_zhi.story_zh: 「一骑红尘妃子笑，无人知是荔枝来。」夏季空运到店，冰镇后剥壳即食。
li_zhi.story_en: "A courier's dust made the imperial consort smile — it was lychees." Air-flown in summer; chill, peel, enjoy.
li_zhi.recipe_zh: 冰镇直接吃最好。剩下的去核冻起来，加气泡水就是荔枝冰饮。
li_zhi.recipe_en: Best chilled and eaten fresh. Freeze pitted extras — drop into sparkling water for lychee soda.

_festival_crops._comment: Only appear during festival windows. Not in main rotation.

narcissus.story_zh: 南方春节必备的水仙花，象征「凌波仙子」。东方超市春节前会到货水培装。
narcissus.story_en: A Lunar New Year flower especially in southern China. Eastern Market stocks bulbs before the festival.

kumquat.story_zh: 「桔」与「吉」同音。家家户户摆一盆年橘讨吉利。
kumquat.story_en: The Cantonese word for kumquat sounds like 'lucky'. Every household displays one at New Year.

taro.story_zh: 中秋拜月时供品。蒸熟后软糯，可甜可咸。
taro.story_en: An offering during Mid-Autumn moon-worship. Steamed, it's soft and sweet.

pomelo.story_zh: 中秋月圆，柚子也圆。吃完柚子皮还能做帽子。
pomelo.story_en: Round like the full moon. Kids wear the rind as hats — try it!

osmanthus.story_zh: 「八月桂花遍地开」。香气可入酒、入糕、入茶。
osmanthus.story_en: August osmanthus blossoms — can be infused into wine, cakes, and tea.
